question: Who is the author of "The God of Small Things"?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Arundhati Roy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arundhati Roy** is the author of the novel **"The God of Small Things."**
 
• The book was published in **1997** and won the prestigious **Man Booker Prize** for Fiction in the same year.
 
• The novel is set in the southern Indian state of **Kerala** and explores themes such as **family, social discrimination, and forbidden love.**
 
• **Arundhati Roy** is an Indian author, activist, and political commentator known for her strong views on social justice and environmental issues.
 
• "The God of Small Things" is considered a masterpiece of modern literature and has been translated into **more than 40 languages.**
 
• The story revolves around the lives of two twins, **Estha** and **Rahel**, and their family’s tragic history, set against the backdrop of the socio-political landscape of India.
 
• The novel incorporates a unique narrative style, using **non-linear storytelling** and poetic prose to evoke emotions and create vivid imagery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie**__

 __
 
• **Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie** is a Nigerian author known for her works such as **"Half of a Yellow Sun," "Purple Hibiscus,"** and **"Americanah."**
 
• She is celebrated for her exploration of themes like **identity, feminism, race, and politics.**
 
 
 
• **Neil Gaiman**__
 __
 
• **Neil Gaiman** is a British author best known for his works in the **fantasy and science fiction genres.**
 
• Some of his famous books include **"American Gods," "Coraline,"** and **"The Sandman" series.**
 
 
 
• **Mo Yan**__
 
 
• **Mo Yan** is a Chinese author who won the **Nobel Prize in Literature** in 2012.
 
• He is known for his works such as **"Red Sorghum Clan" and "Big Breasts and Wide Hips,"** which explore Chinese history and culture.
